key_insight: The paper shows that several commonly used continuity equations in Generalised Lagrangian Mean theory are mathematically incomplete unless extra compatibility conditions are added.
engineering_relevance: This clarifies when GLM-style mean-flow models can be trusted in turbulent flow analysis and how to extend them to arbitrary fluid motion.
method: Derives the actual velocity divergence in terms of averaged Eulerian quantities
Formulates three exact continuity-equation variants and identifies what is missing in each
Restores validity by introducing compatibility equations and comparing them with McIntyre-Andrews Transformations
evidence_signal: The paper is a theory/derivation study based on exact formulae and general fluid-dynamic statements rather than numerical experiments or datasets.
watch_item: The original MAT applies only under special flow assumptions, so implementations must enforce the required auxiliary PDE and compatibility conditions before using these continuity forms.
paper_title: Continuity equations in the Generalised Lagrangian Mean theory
